$comment: The roster under test. To benchmark a newly released model, add one entry and run:
'openai-compatible' — openai SDK + baseURL override. Covers OpenAI, OpenRouter,
Z.ai, Moonshot, DashScope, xAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Together.
'manual'            — no API. The runner skips it; you produce each deliverable in
the harness and drop it at runs/<id>/<benchmark>/index.html.
Scoring is identical to an API-generated run.
Models whose apiKeyEnv is unset are SKIPPED (not failed) by --all.
params are passed to the provider verbatim — per-model tuning goes there.
KEYS NEEDED FOR THIS ROSTER: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GLM_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY
(+ DASHSCOPE_API_KEY for Qwen). Every OpenRouter entry can be pointed at its vendor's
direct endpoint instead — swap baseURL + apiKeyEnv and drop the vendor/ prefix.

models.$comment: Anthropic's most capable model. Thinking is always on — the thinking parameter is omitted deliberately, since an explicit config is rejected. Requires 30-day data retention: under ZDR every request 400s. Safety classifiers can return stop_reason refusal, which the provider surfaces as a clear error.
models.label: Claude Fable 5

models.label: Cursor Composer 2.5

models.$comment: Moved off the Z.ai coding-plan endpoint (https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4, model 'glm-5.2', GLM_API_KEY) to OpenRouter. GLM 5.2 spends its output budget on reasoning before emitting content, so at max_tokens 64000 it truncated or returned an EMPTY body (finish_reason: length) on the harder briefs — 01 produced 2kb after ten minutes, 10 produced nothing at all. OpenRouter publishes max_completion_tokens 131072 for this model, so 64000 was our ceiling, not the model's. Raising it to 128000 is the fix; do not lower it, which forces truncation rather than preventing it. The Z.ai route still works for lighter tasks if you want it back.
models.label: GLM 5.2

models.$comment: vision:false is a conservative default — it only affects the judge audit, which sends screenshots to every model in this roster. If DeepSeek's OpenRouter route does accept image input, flip it to true; if it does not and this is left unset, every audit call for this model 404s with 'No endpoints found that support image input' (the failure qwen3.7-max hit). Generation is unaffected either way.
models.label: DeepSeek V4 Pro

models.$comment: Meta's Muse Spark 1.2 (coding-focused update, released via Meta Model API). Verified in the OpenRouter catalog as meta/muse-spark-1.2: 1M context, image input supported (so no vision:false), $1.25/M in, $4.25/M out, no published max_completion_tokens cap. max_tokens 128000 because it reasons inside the output budget (a 'Say READY' probe burned ~270 reasoning tokens and returned an EMPTY body at max_tokens 64) — the same failure mode that truncated GLM 5.2 at 64000; do not lower it. GATE: OpenRouter 403s on this model until the account confirms 18+ age attestation at https://openrouter.ai/settings/preferences — one-time, account-level. Direct alternative: Meta Model API at https://api.meta.ai/v1 (OpenAI-compatible), model 'muse-spark-1.2', key from the Meta Developer Console — swap baseURL/apiKeyEnv/model to use it.
models.label: Muse Spark 1.2

models.$comment: Verified present in the OpenRouter catalog. Qwen 3.8 Max Preview is not published there yet; swap model/baseURL/apiKeyEnv to DashScope if you get direct access. vision:false because no OpenRouter endpoint for this model accepts image input — without it every judge-audit call 404s. Only the audit reads this flag; it does not affect generation.
models.label: Qwen 3.7 Max
